scope: Local CMS API foundation, production Next build and real PostgreSQL; no public deployment

checks.name: home search reaches real catalog and combined filters
document renders real PNG, zoom, download policy and persisted favorites
author signs in through the UI and cannot access moderation
guest favorites transfer explicitly and synchronize across two browser sessions
document exposes actual OCR text and similar document links
assistant shows actual mode, document and guide links, and unknown-answer state
comment UI publishes clean text, rejects a contextual Unicode bypass, and queues a quote
moderator reviews the real pending comment through the UI
report, hide and restore persist an auditable decision history
reply form creates a private notification, preferences persist and another account cannot read it
signing out in another tab immediately hides account favorites
WCAG automated checks and responsive layout across RU/KK, light/dark and three widths
keyboard skip link and logout revoke the actual browser session

docker.target: isolated local Docker projects, not a public deployment

checks.name: runtime is non-root and both images exclude environment files
fresh Compose stack initializes schema, original assets and two accounts
standalone runtime serves a PNG and persists an authenticated comment
CMS creates independent reviewed translations and archive hierarchy in Compose
database and app restart preserve the marker comment and file volume
backup includes private database and files with an integrity manifest
same-project, corrupted-backup and occupied-volume restore fail before changing resources
restore to a fresh project recovers the marker, users and exact file bytes
CMS roles, hierarchy, translations, private history and notices survive backup and restore
favorites, notification preferences and reply events survive restart and restore

limitations: Real archive content and policy not approved
No public HTTPS or remote CI execution verified
